method: Union of (1) Fortnite Esports Wiki (Fandom) Cargo table Players where InputDevice="Controller" (670 pages; queried via api.php action=cargoquery) and (2) ProSettings.net Fortnite list (319 pros) whose player page has a Controller settings/binds section. Liquipedia does not record input. sim_ovr = best ovr of the same handle+region in fncsdraftmajor/tools/measured/player-handles.json (handle match only, verify namesakes).
caveats: Fandom InputDevice is the CURRENT input as last edited; it does not record switches.
Handle collisions: same handle in different regions may be different people (e.g. Frosty, Rise, FHD, Unknown).
ProSettings pages with both KBM and controller sections are flagged medium (hybrid page).
